whyItMatters: a MongoDB DSN with inline credentials assigned to MONGO_DSN with an inline password hands the account to everyone who can read the file, and the password does not rotate itself.
actions: Rotate the account used by the connection string.
Move the URL into the environment or a secret manager and reference it by name.
Check logs and backups for the same URL and purge them.
verification: The old password no longer authenticates and no URL with an inline password remains at this name.
